plan.notes: Official East Carolina University 2026-2027 Elementary Education (K-6) BS requirements (ECU Degree Explorer). The catalog publishes official degree requirements with no official semester sequence; collected as a single requirements block. ECU publishes block-level semester-hour totals but NOT per-course credit values on the program page; recorded as official block totals at catalog minimums (Gen Ed 40, Professional studies 28, one 12 s.h. concentration of 12-18, Specialty 24, Cognates 16 of 16-19 = 120 s.h.). Per-course credits were not invented. Supplemental NC transfer guide (2026-2027, revised April 2026) publishes per-course credits for some ELEM/MATE/READ/SCIE courses; cited as reference only, not extrapolated.

courses.title: General Education (40 s.h.)
courses.choice_note: 40 s.h. general education block; per-course credits not published on program page. Includes: ART 3850 or MATH 1065 or MATH 2127; MUSC 3018; 3 s.h. humanities (literature); additional gen ed courses to 40 s.h. Supplemental: NC transfer guide (2026-2027) publishes per-course credits for some ELEM/MATE/READ/SCIE courses; used only where it maps exactly.

courses.title: Professional studies (28 s.h.)
courses.choice_note: 28 s.h. professional studies block; per-course credits not published. Courses: EDTC 4001 Technology in Education; one diversity course (EDUC 2003, EDUC 3002, PSYC 2777, SOCI 1010, SOCI 2111, or approved elective); EDUC 3200; ELEM 2123; ELEM 4324 Internship in the Elementary School; ELEM 4325 Internship Seminar; READ 3501; SPED 4020.

courses.title: Academic concentration (12 s.h., catalog range 12-18; choose one)
courses.choice_note: Choose one academic concentration, 12-18 s.h., recorded at minimum 12. Options: (a) Academically and Intellectually Gifted 18 s.h. (GIFT 4000, 4100, 4200, 4300 + 6 s.h. electives); (b) Birth through Kindergarten (HDFS 2000, 3150, 3306, 3321, 4121, 4122); (c) Content Integration Generalist; (d) English; (e) General Science; (f) History; (g) Interdisciplinary Human Studies; (h) Mathematics Education; (i) Psychology; (j) Reading add-on licensure; (k) Social Studies. Per-course credits not published on program page.

courses.title: Specialty area (24 s.h.)
courses.choice_note: 24 s.h. specialty area block; per-course credits not published. Courses: ELEM 3000, 3100, 3215, 3300, 3500, 3600, 4300, 4400 (titles per official program page).

courses.title: Cognates (16 s.h., catalog range 16-19)
courses.choice_note: Cognates block: catalog range 16-19 s.h., recorded at minimum 16. Per-course credits not published on program page. Courses: ENGL 3950 or LIBS 4950 (counts as gen ed humanities; if so, 16 s.h. cognates count); MATE 2129, 3050, 3051, 3060; READ 3502; SCIE 3216.
